content.short: ORA is a verifiable AI oracle that brings complex machine learning and AI computation directly on-chain.
content.description:
ORA Protocol is a pioneering verifiable AI oracle designed to enable decentralized applications to integrate artificial intelligence and complex machine learning models with cryptographic integrity. Utilizing its proprietary Optimistic Machine Learning (opML) technology, ORA achieves high-performance on-chain inference at a fraction of the cost of zero-knowledge alternatives. The platform's flagship Onchain AI Oracle (OAO) allows smart contracts to trustlessly call advanced models like LLaMA 3 and Stable Diffusion for a wide variety of use cases.

Beyond its oracle capabilities, ORA introduces the Initial Model Offering (IMO), a mechanism that tokenizes AI models using the ERC-7641 standard, allowing creators to capture revenue from model usage. Trusted by major DeFi protocols, ORA serves as a foundational infrastructure for the "AI-Fi" era, bridging the gap between sophisticated intelligence and blockchain-based settlement. Through its commitment to transparency and verifiable compute, ORA is empowering the next generation of builders to create more intelligent, automated, and secure decentralized applications.
